title: Traffic light
description:
Model a traffic light as a small state machine. Define `enum class Light { green, yellow, red };` and write:

| Function | Returns |
|---|---|
| `Light next(Light now)` | the light that follows: green, then yellow, then red, then green again |
| `int seconds(Light light)` | how long it stays on: green 30, yellow 5, red 25 |
| `std::string_view action(Light light)` | `"go"`, `"slow down"` or `"stop"` |
| `int secondsFor(Light start, int changes)` | total time spent, starting at `start` and showing `changes` lights in a row (including the first) |

`secondsFor(Light::green, 3)` is 30 + 5 + 25 = 60.
hints: `secondsFor` is a loop that uses the other two functions: add `seconds(light)`, then move on with `light = next(light)`.
